title: Toast and log count customers moved to COD
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a new term of the shop's own for this test, term A, due 20 days after the invoice date.
  • Create two customers for this test on term A.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "COD" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 2 Customers".
  5. Click "Set Limits To $0 And Move".
  6. Open the "⋯" page menu.
  7. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The count reads "2 selected".

Step 3:

  • The $0 line shows.

Step 4:

  • The confirmation title reads "Set 2 customers' credit limit to $0?".

Step 5:

  • The toast reads "2 customers moved to COD."

Step 6:

  • The menu opens.

Step 7:

  • The newest row reads "2 customers from term A to COD" followed by "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
